data.one_liner: A Dart library for geodesic and trigonometric calculations with geographical points and paths.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of methods for performing geodetic calculations like distance calculations, point intersections, bearings, and destinations based on a spherical Earth model. It is designed to work with geographical coordinates in the form of latitude and longitude.
use_when: You need to calculate distances, bearings, or destinations between geographical coordinates.
You are working with paths, polylines, or polygons and need to measure lengths or areas.
avoid_when: You need an interactive map UI widget rather than just backend/mathematical geodetic calculations.
strengths: Comprehensive collection of geodetic and trigonometric calculation methods.
Supports static methods without needing an instance.
Includes support for metric unit conversions and polygon area calculations.
weaknesses: Relies on a spherical Earth model rather than a fully ellipsoidal model for all operations.
Limited documentation embedded directly in README besides external links.
